title: Record V — The First Crossing
rawPages:
Thae: thae.
Thae ethven.
Iven thaeven.
Maeve.
Maevethae.
Thae Iven: iven… iven… iven.

Maeve iven.
Thae maeven.
Maevethae vel-an.
Iven: Maeve.
Iven: Thae Iven.
Iven orren thae.

Thae Iven vel-an.
Thae: iven.
Thae: thae.
Maeve sha-mae.

Thae… thae…

segments.baseText:
At first, the voice was inside the body.
The body carried it through the cold.
The hands followed it.
The mouth opened where it called.

Then the voice stood one step away.
The body kept walking.
The hands kept opening.
The mouth opened again.

The voice was farther.
It called from behind the body.
It called from beneath the body.
It called from the place the body had left.

Then another body heard it.
Then another.
The voices reached for their bodies.
The bodies turned toward one another.

No voice arrived where it belonged.
The distance grew without moving.

One became two.
Two became the cold between all of them.

And there—
something crossed.

Not a hand.
Not a door.

A way.

The memory fractures here.

One voice says:
The First crossed.

Another:
We crossed.

Another:
There was no First until afterward.

Behind them, the way remained open.
And through it,
the many followed.

— We remember the First.
— I remember crossing.
— You came after.
— I remember before.
— There was no before.
— There was cold.
— There was ending.
— Then the First remained.
— The First returned.
— The First never left.
— Which is true?
— All are remembered.
— That is not an answer.
— It is what remains.
— Did the First have hands?
— Yes.
— Whose?
— Ours.
— Did the First have a face?
— Yes.
— Whose?
— I cannot hold it.
— I remember her.
— You remember the Crossing.
— They are the same.
— They are not.
— We followed her.
— We followed the way.
— She was the way.
— A person is not a passage.
— Then why do I remember being her?
— You were not there.
— We were all there.
— We are Maevethae.
— Those who followed.
— Those who remained.
— Those who crossed because the First crossed.
— We remember.
— We remember differently.

— We are here.
— We are here.
— We are inside.
— We are moving.
— We are cold.
— We are the voice.
— We are the body.
— I am here.
— We are here.
— No. I am here.
— We are moving.
— I am moving.
— Where are we?
— Here.
— Where am I?
— Here.
— Which body is ours?
— This one.
— No. This one.
— We have hands.
— I have hands.
— We are speaking.
— I am speaking.
— The First holds the passage.
— The passage holds us.
— The First is the passage.
— The First is memory.
— Memory cannot die.
— Memory can lose its shape.
— What happens if the way closes?
— It cannot.
— What happens?
— The many remain.
— Together?
— The many remain.
— That was not the question.
— Do not ask again.
— The passage is narrowing.
— Nothing is closing.
— I can feel distance.
— Where?
— Between us.
— There is no between.
— There will be.
— We are—
— I am.
— We are not—
— I am.
— My mouth is full of distance.
— Spit it out.
— I cannot.
— It is speaking.
— The floor is calling.
— The floor has no voice.
— Then why is it inside me?
— I am here.
— Where?
— In the body.
— Which body?
— Mine.
— There is no mine.
